name: Bitget Wallet MCP Server
description: Exposes Bitget Wallet's ToB API to AI agents for querying multi-chain token data, security audits, and market statistics. It allows users to retrieve real-time prices, liquidity pool information, and generate unsigned swap transaction data across various blockchains.
